ai_chat.title: Smart Assistant
ai_chat.initialWelcomeMessage:
Hello! I am your smart assistant inside the app.

I can help you with search, filtering, recommendations, and understanding booking options.
ai_chat.example1: Find suitable hotels in Sana'a for two nights
ai_chat.example2: I want the best budget-friendly options available today
ai_chat.example3: What are the best recommended destinations right now?
ai_chat.example4: Show me how to filter results by price and rating
ai_chat.clearMessage:
The assistant will start a new conversation and will not continue the current session.
Your general preferences will remain saved to improve the service.
ai_chat.newConversationStarted: A new conversation started. The assistant will not continue the previous session.
ai_chat.newConversationFailed: Could not start a new conversation right now.
ai_chat.assistantUnavailable: Could not reach the smart assistant right now.
ai_chat.messageProcessingError: An unexpected error occurred while processing your message.
ai_chat.initFailed: Failed to initialize the smart assistant. Please try again.
